note: The naming rules of the SACM instruction, as data. Patterns are regular expressions; upper and lower case count. 'when': only names that match it are tested. The check packs name the rules they apply (detector.rules). Decision of 11 Nov 2026, to confirm: the instruction writes "API-", but the API offerings in ServiceNow are written "API - " with spaces, so the rule follows the data.

rules.say: The name does not end with _BA
The name does not end with _BS
The name does not end with " - PROD" or " - TEST"
The name of an API offering does not start with "API - "
rules.set: Start the name with "API - " (API, space, hyphen, space)

rules.say: The name has a space at its start or its end
